title: 第1章 绑定系统
slug: 七天后穿越我提前囤货躲灾年
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“总感觉这个世界有什么在等着我，现在我知道了，是报应。”

谭筝坐在跨江大桥的护栏上，惆怅望天。

一个路过的外卖员冲了上来，大吼道：“妹子！你可千万不要想不开做傻事啊！想想你的家人们！”

“家人？”谭筝喃喃着扭头。

“我爸是个酒鬼，一喝酒就打人；我妈重男轻女，眼里只有弟弟；我弟是个精神小伙，上个月飙车，卸载了蛋蛋，成了我妹。”

“噢，还有我奶，痴迷养生，为了跟别的阿婆抢童子尿，摔倒后瘫在了床上；我爷搞夕阳红黄昏恋，天天去公园和老太太跳舞，前两天刚查出的艾滋……”

这一家都是什么奇葩？？？

外卖员有些尴尬，咳嗽了两声，继续说：“那朋友呢？你要是死了，你的那些小姐妹该多难过啊？”

“我下班回家，看到男朋友和闺蜜在颠鸾倒凤，不知天地为何物，闺蜜的身上穿着我刚买的蕾丝睡裙，喊得比楼下晨练的大爷还有劲。”

听完这话，外卖员眼前一黑，想要再劝，可憋了半天，只吐几个字出来。

“你……这……我……哎……”

这操蛋的人生，搁谁身上受得了啊！

谭筝苦笑一声，正准备往下跳时，一股无形的力量拉住了她。

与此同时，一道机械音在她耳边响起。

【系统绑定中。】

嗯？什么鬼动静？

【绑定成功！】

【七天后，宿主将会被传输到古代灾年，请宿主准备好所需物资。】

【登录即送：无限随身空间×1，金币×1000000】

下一秒，手机屏幕亮起，谭筝点开短信一开，余额变成了1019528元。

多了整整一百万！！！

谭筝一下子头也不疼了，腿也不酸了，就连坐在护栏上的屁股都更有力了，生怕一个不小心就掉下去。

有钱有系统，终于要轮到她走上人生巅峰了吗？！

七天，她还有七天的时间可以疯狂买买买。

到了古代，她就可以躺平当米虫，再也不用上那钱少事多还单休的破班了！

想到这，谭筝扒拉着护栏，准备往回挪。

可这一举动落入外卖员的眼中，就成了她要跳河的证据。

“妹子！别乱动！我——来——救——你——了——”

"I always feel like there is something waiting for me in this world. Now I know it is retribution."

Tan Zheng sat on the guardrail of the bridge across the river, looking at the sky melancholy.

A passing delivery boy rushed up and yelled: "Sister! Don't do stupid things out of your mind! Think about your family!"

"Family?" Tan Zheng murmured and turned his head.

"My father is an alcoholic and beats people when he drinks; my mother is patriarchal and only cares about her younger brother; my younger brother is a spirited young man who went racing last month and unloaded his balls and became my younger sister."

"Oh, there is also my grandma, who is obsessed with health care. He fell and collapsed on the bed in order to compete with other grandmothers for child urine; my father has a love affair with the sunset and goes to the park to dance with the old lady every day. He was just diagnosed with AIDS two days ago..."

What's so weird about this family???

The delivery boy was a little embarrassed, coughed twice, and continued: "What about my friend? If you die, how sad will your little sisters be?"

"I came home from get off work and saw my boyfriend and my best friend having an affair. I didn't know what to make of it. My best friend was wearing a lace nightgown I just bought and she was shouting louder than the guy doing morning exercises downstairs."

After hearing this, the deliveryman's vision went dark and he wanted to persuade her again, but he held it in for a long time and could only utter a few words.

"You...this...I...hey..."

Who can bear this fucked up life?

Tan Zheng smiled bitterly, and when she was about to jump down, an invisible force pulled her.

At the same time, a mechanical sound sounded in her ears.

[System binding is in progress.】

Um?What the hell is going on?

[Binding successful!】

[Seven days later, the host will be transported to the ancient disaster year. Please prepare the necessary supplies.】

[Get a gift when you log in: unlimited portable space × 1, gold coins × 1,000,000]

The next second, the phone screen lit up, Tan Zheng clicked on the text message, and the balance became 1,019,528 yuan.

A whole million more!!!

Tan Zheng suddenly no longer had a headache, his legs were no longer sore, and even his buttocks sitting on the guardrail became stronger, for fear of falling down accidentally.

With money and a system, is it finally her turn to reach the top of her life?!

Seven days, she still has seven days to go shopping like crazy.

In ancient times, she could just lie down and be a worm, and no longer have to work in that miserable job with less money, more work, and only one day off!

Thinking of this, Tan Zheng pulled on the guardrail and prepared to move back.

But this move fell into the eyes of the deliveryman and became evidence that she wanted to jump into the river.

"Sister! Don't move! I'm here to save you."
